scope: Original-method execution and compatibility with the existing candidate-selection benchmark
prohibited_changes: Adding our EBLC, generated CNL, solver verdicts, or missing supplied rules to external methods
Replacing original models with Qwen and calling the result an original-method reproduction
Converting native logic/VQA/planning output into candidate labels without a separately authorized adaptation
Creating new human annotations or reference labels
Reporting native demonstration outputs as six-task candidate-selection accuracy
intrinsic_requirements: Original natural-language specifications and few-shot examples intrinsic to nl2spec/NL2TL are retained. No additional driving restrictions are inserted.

native_checks.nl2spec: Unmodified upstream CLI, README example, gpt-3.5-turbo, minimal prompt, three samples, temperature 0.2; automatic first pass only, no interactive human correction
native_checks.NL2TL: Official checkpoint-62500, t5-base tokenizer, eleven examples from Run.ipynb, original prefix and generation settings, seed 42; inference demonstration only
native_checks.DriveLM: Inspect official challenge implementation, original LLaMA-7B dependency, bundled multi-view data and native evaluation format
native_checks.DriveVLM: Inspect all advertised official repository branches for released model implementation/checkpoints

comparison_gate: Common-task performance requires original methods to consume available inputs and produce scoreable outputs under the same reference semantics. Native demonstrations alone do not pass this gate.
stop_conditions: Incompatible native task requiring a new method
manuscript_policy: Do not insert external performance numbers or plots until common-task evaluation is actually executed. Record resource and task blockers separately.
